description:
Halnon Humphreys Estate Agents are thrilled to bring to the market this remarkable 4-bedroom detached coastal property extending to c. 135 sq m/1453 sq ft and featuring spacious rooms and an excellent B3 energy rating. The property comes to the market in fabulous condition having been meticulously maintained by the current owner and will make a great family home or beautiful seaside getaway.

Location:
A wide variety of activities and amenities are on your doorstep, with beautiful beaches, forest walks, top golf courses and internationally acclaimed spa's catering to your every requirement. This friendly coastal location provides numerous eateries, cafe's, bars and plenty to keep the kids entertained by way of ten pin bowling, amusements, crazy golf and a host of other leisurely activities. Located less than an hour from Dublin, Aylesbridge is an ideal coastal getaway surrounded by an array of amenities, perfect for family living.

Accommodation:
The ground floor of this attractive property offers a large entrance hallway with understairs storage and it connects to a bright and spacious family sitting room. To the rear lies the kitchen and dining area providing a large open plan feel maximising the light and double doors to the rear garden. There is an adjoining utility room and a beautifully tiled WC. 
On the first floor there are four bedrooms with the main bedroom offering an ensuite bathroom and balcony. A large family bathroom completes the first floor accommodation. 

Outside:
The property offers driveway parking for two cars to the front with additional communal parking located directly across from the property. The rear garden is fully enclosed by both block wall and timber fencing. There is with gated access both sides of the residence and there is a lawn area with decking located off dining room of the property. There are also two Barna sheds for storage in the rear garden.

Services:
Services include oil fired central heating, mains water & sewage and high-speed broadband is available in the area.

Features:
